sentences.en: WOMAN: I've been reading your personal statement, Paul.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 我一直在阅读你的个人陈述，保罗。

sentences.en: First, let's talk about your work experience in South America.
sentences.zh: 首先，让我们谈谈你在南美洲的工作经历。

sentences.en: What took you there?
sentences.zh: 是什么促使你去那里的？

sentences.en: Was it to gain more fluency in Spanish?
sentences.zh: 是为了进一步提高西班牙语的流利程度吗？

sentences.en: PAUL: Well, as I'm combining Spanish with Latin American studies, my main idea was to find out more about the way people lived there.
sentences.zh: PAUL: 嗯，由于我将西班牙语与拉丁美洲研究相结合，我的主要想法是更深入地了解当地人的生活方式。

sentences.en: My spoken Spanish was already pretty good in fact.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我的口语西班牙语已经相当不错了。

sentences.en: WOMAN: So you weren't too worried about language barriers?
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 所以你对语言障碍并不太担心？

sentences.en: PAUL: No.
sentences.zh: PAUL: 不担心。

sentences.en: In fact, I ended up teaching English there, although that wasn't my original choice of work.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我最终在当地教英语，尽管这并非我最初选择的工作。

sentences.en: WOMAN: see.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 明白了。

sentences.en: How did you find out about all this?
sentences.zh: 你是如何了解到这些机会的？

sentences.en: PAUL: found an agency that runs all kinds of voluntary projects in South America.
sentences.zh: PAUL: 我找到了一家在南美洲运营各类志愿项目的机构。

sentences.en: WOMAN: What kind of work?
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 具体是哪类工作？

sentences.en: PAUL: Well, there were several possibilities.
sentences.zh: PAUL: 嗯，有好几种可能性。

sentences.en: WOMAN: You mean construction?
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 你是说建筑工作？

sentences.en: Engineering work?
sentences.zh: 工程类工作？

sentences.en: PAUL: Yes, getting involved in building projects was an option.
sentences.zh: PAUL: 是的，参与建筑工程是一个选项。

sentences.en: Then there was tourism - taking tourists for walks around the volcanoes - which I actually chose to do, and then there was work with local farmers.
sentences.zh: 此外还有旅游业——带领游客徒步游览火山——我实际上选择了这项工作；另外还有协助当地农民的工作。

sentences.en: WOMAN: But you didn't continue with that project.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 但你并没有继续参与那个农业项目。

sentences.en: Why not?
sentences.zh: 为什么呢？

sentences.en: PAUL: Because I never really knew whether I'd be needed or not.
sentences.zh: PAUL: 因为我始终不确定自己是否真的会被需要。

sentences.en: I'd thought it might be difficult physically, but I was certainly fit enough . . . no, I wanted to do something that had more of a proper structure to it, I suppose.
sentences.zh: 我原以为体力上可能比较吃力，但我身体确实足够强健……不，我想做一件结构更明确、更有条理的事情，我想大概就是这样。

sentences.en: I get de-motivated otherwise.
sentences.zh: 否则我会失去动力。

sentences.en: WOMAN: What do you think you learned from your experience?
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 你觉得这段经历让你学到了什么？

sentences.en: It must have been a great opportunity to examine community life.
sentences.zh: 这一定是一次极好的机会，来观察社区生活。

sentences.en: PAUL: Yes, but it was difficult at first to be accepted by the locals.
sentences.zh: PAUL: 是的，但起初很难被当地人接纳。

sentences.en: It was a very remote village and some of them were reluctant to speak to me - although they were always interested in my clothes and how much I'd had to pay for them.
sentences.zh: 那是个非常偏远的村庄，其中一些人不太愿意和我说话——尽管他们总是对我穿的衣服以及我为此花了多少钱很感兴趣。

sentences.en: WOMAN: Well, that's understandable.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 嗯，这完全可以理解。

sentences.en: PAUL: Yes, but things soon improved.
sentences.zh: PAUL: 是的，但情况很快便好转了。

sentences.en: What struck me was that when people became more comfortable with me and less suspicious, we really connected with each other in a meaningful way.
sentences.zh: 令我印象深刻的是，当人们逐渐对我感到更自在、戒备心减少后，我们之间便真正建立起一种有意义的联结。

sentences.en: WOMAN: You made good friends?
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 你交到了好朋友？

sentences.en: PAUL: Yes, with two of the families in particular.
sentences.zh: PAUL: 是的，尤其和其中两个家庭建立了深厚的友谊。

sentences.en: WOMAN: Good.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 很好。

sentences.en: What about management.
sentences.zh: 那么管理方面呢？

sentences.en: Did you have a project manager?
sentences.zh: 你们有项目经理吗？

sentences.en: PAUL: Yes and he gave me lots of advice and guidance.
sentences.zh: PAUL: 有，他给了我大量建议和指导。

sentences.en: WOMAN: And was he good at managing too?
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 那他本身也擅长管理吗？

sentences.en: www.TopSage.com Tapescripts +.
sentences.zh: www.TopSage.com 录音稿 +

sentences.en: SLAB
sentences.zh: SLAB

sentences.en: PAUL: That wasn't his strong point!
sentences.zh: PAUL: 这可不是他的强项！

sentences.en: I think he was often more interested in the academic side of things than filing reports.
sentences.zh: 我觉得他往往对学术方面比撰写报告更感兴趣。

sentences.en: He was a bit a
sentences.zh: 他有点儿……

sentences.en: WOMAN: And did you have a contract?
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 那您当时有签订合同吗？

sentences.en: of a dreamer.Sage.com
sentences.zh: 是个梦想家。Sage.com

sentences.en: PAUL: had to stay for a minimum of three months.
sentences.zh: PAUL: 必须至少待满三个月。

sentences.en: My parents were surprised when I asked to stay longer - six months in the end. was so happy there.
sentences.zh: 我父母得知我想延长停留时间时都很惊讶——最后待了六个月。我在那里非常开心。

sentences.en: WOMAN: And did anything on the administration side of things surprise you?
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 那么，行政事务方面有没有什么让您感到意外的？

sentences.en: What was the food and lodging like?
sentences.zh: 那里的饮食和住宿情况如何？

sentences.en: PAUL: Simple …. but there was plenty to eat and I only paid seven dollars a day for that which was amazing really.
sentences.zh: PAUL: 很简单……但食物很充足，而且我每天只需支付七美元，这真的令人惊讶。

sentences.en: And they gave me all the equipment I needed .
sentences.zh: 而且他们为我提供了所需的所有设备。

sentences.en: even a laptop.
sentences.zh: 甚至包括一台笔记本电脑。

sentences.en: WOMAN: You didn't expect that then?
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 您之前没料到会这样吧？

sentences.en: PAUL: No.
sentences.zh: PAUL: 没有。

sentences.en: WOMAN: Well, I'll look forward to hearing more.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 好的，我很期待之后听到更多内容。

sentences.en: WOMAN: But now let's look at these modules.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 不过现在，我们来看看这些课程模块。

sentences.en: You'll need to start thinking about which ones you'll definitely want to study.
sentences.zh: 您需要开始考虑哪些模块是您确定想修读的。

sentences.en: The first one here is Gender Studies in Latin America.
sentences.zh: 第一个模块是《拉丁美洲的性别研究》。

sentences.en: PAUL: Mmm . . .
sentences.zh: PAUL: 嗯……

sentences.en: WOMAN: It looks at how gender analysis is reconfiguring civil society in Latin America.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 该课程探讨性别分析如何重构拉丁美洲的公民社会。

sentences.en: Women are increasingly occupying positions in government and in other elected leadership positions in Latin America.
sentences.zh: 女性在拉丁美洲政府及其他民选领导职位中所占比例正日益提高。

sentences.en: I think you'd find it interesting.
sentences.zh: 我想您会觉得这门课很有趣。

sentences.en: PAUL: If it was to do with people in the villages rather than those in the public sphere, I would.
sentences.zh: PAUL: 如果课程内容聚焦于村庄里的民众，而非公共领域中的人士，那我会感兴趣。

sentences.en: WOMAN: Okay.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 好的。

sentences.en: What about Second Language Acquisition?
sentences.zh: 那么，《第二语言习得》这门课呢？

sentences.en: PAUL: Do you think I'd find that useful?
sentences.zh: PAUL: 您觉得我会觉得这门课有用吗？

sentences.en: WOMAN: Well, you've had some practical experience in the field, I think it would be.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 嗯，您已在该领域积累了一些实践经验，我认为它会对您有帮助。

sentences.en: PAUL: hadn't thought about that.
sentences.zh: PAUL: 我之前还真没想过这一点。

sentences.en: I'll put that down as a definite, then.
sentences.zh: 那我就把它列为必修课吧。

sentences.en: WOMAN: Okay.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 好的。

sentences.en: What about Indigenous Women's Lives.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 那么，《原住民女性的生活》这门课呢？

sentences.en: That sounds appropriate.
sentences.zh: 听起来挺合适的。

sentences.en: PAUL: thought so too, but looked at last year's exam questions and that changed my mind.
sentences.zh: PAUL: 我之前也这么认为，但看了去年的考试题目后，就改变了主意。

sentences.en: WOMAN: Don't judge the value of the course on that.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 别仅凭考试题来判断这门课的价值。

sentences.en: Maybe, talk to some other students first and we can talk about it again later.
sentences.zh: 也许您可以先和其他同学交流一下，之后我们再就此进一步讨论。

sentences.en: PAUL: Okay.
sentences.zh: PAUL: 好的。

sentences.en: WOMAN: Yes.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 是的。

sentences.en: And lastly, will you sign up for Portuguese lessons?
sentences.zh: 最后，您会报名葡萄牙语课程吗？

sentences.en: PAUL: My Spanish is good, so would find that module easy?
sentences.zh: PAUL: 我的西班牙语很好，所以学这门课会很容易吗？

sentences.en: WOMAN: Not necessarily.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 不一定。

sentences.en: Some people find that Spanish interferes with learning Portuguese .
sentences.zh: 有些人发现西班牙语反而会干扰葡萄牙语的学习。

sentences.en: getting the accent right too.
sentences.zh: 把口音发准确也很重要。

sentences.en: It's quite different in a lot of a ways.
sentences.zh: 在很多方面都相当不同。

sentences.en: PAUL: Well, I'd much sooner do something else, then.
sentences.zh: PAUL: 那我宁愿去做点别的事情。

sentences.en: WOMAN: Alright.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 好的。

sentences.en: Now, what we need to do is
sentences.zh: 现在，我们需要做的是
